status: design frozen before CAD features or fitting; membership awaits full semantic review
representation: Same original system/task/RULE and two canonical option maps as W; float64 mean hidden then frozen W author-train PH scaler; batch size 1; full strings, no truncation.
offset: Stable log odds of mean aligned native probabilities; exact explicit mean-vector ties set to zero; assert original positive-first decisions; no clipping.
objective: Weighted binary NLL plus L2 coefficient penalty, unpenalized intercept, fixed native offset except rp_plain. sklearn stable LinearModelLoss kernel; l2_reg_strength=1/(C*sum(weights)).
weights: Total S=4435+retained_train_families; BioNLI total S/2 uniformly by row; CAD total S/2, original E/N/C each 1/3, uniform family within class and uniform included views within family. Identical S and weighted binary prior across arms.
validation: Author val 1109 plus common CAD dev all five views; each domain weight 1/2, CAD stratified by original class then uniform family/view. Choose lowest joint weighted NLL, exact tie smaller C, only converged fits; no refit or threshold selection.
scalar: One native-offset input standardized using weighted RP mixed train only; learn correction plus fixed offset. Report final original-unit slope including offset.
author_preservation: After C selection, each primary backbone must have author-val correct >= W (761/877) AND NLL <= W full-precision selected PH NLL. Failure cannot trigger C reselection.
development_retention: Primary rp_offset only: on both backbones, old J full R5 both >= F (26/33 of40), strong both >= F (8/13 of16), with R5 both strictly greater in each; T64 correct >=native59, strong both >=27/32, R5 both >=28/29 of32, all-four >=12/13 of16. Report all original train/dev slices and controls; do not combine best arms per backbone.
mechanism_claim: Fixed-H P-supervision claim additionally requires primary strictly beats orig_offset, rh_offset and rp_scalar in fixed-H strong both on common CAD dev and T for each backbone, without reduced author preservation. Otherwise report generic augmentation/calibration or unestablished mechanism, even if engineering gate passes.
no_search: No sixth head, new C, representation, class weight, threshold, radius, backbone-specific routing, or D-guided revision in this trial.
data: Agent-reviewed CAD subset, no relabel/no replacement; all five views qualified jointly. Nonmedical auxiliary source, not human reannotation or full CAD replication. Prior source sample exposure disclosed.
D: No access for selection; only consider confirmation after frozen primary passes declared conditions.
interpretation: CAD augmentation, linear residuals and scalar calibration are existing methods; this experiment alone is not a novel algorithm claim.
